title: Is full NS sync being worked on?
body:
Sorry to ask here but I can't find an answer elsewhere. 

Is the intention to go back to full NightScout sync without having to enable engineering mode with a future version. 
Or is the intention to leave it as it is?

comments.body: It is a crucial feature for all parents to have this ability. We need this feature back,
it wil be reenabled once new NSClient is finished
